nodes.description: External payable mint entry point; enforces whitelist, maxSupply, mint fee and per-address mint limit, then calls _bulkClaim with nonReentrant.
Internal bulk mint routine; pulls Bytes via transferFrom then loops claiming traits and mints NFTs.
Weighted pseudo-random trait selector using block.difficulty, block.timestamp, msg.sender and currentIndex as entropy.
Generates trait data for a token, computes rarity and stores packed data into tokenIdToPackedData.
Public function that assigns clearance levels to the reserved first 250 team tokens.
onlyOwner + nonReentrant ETH withdrawal using an unchecked low-level call with value to an arbitrary recipient.
onlyOwner + nonReentrant withdrawal of the contract's ERC20 Bytes balance to a recipient.
onlyOwner clearance upgrade that rewrites the packed data of an existing token.
onlyOwner setter that casts an arbitrary uint256 into the uint208 mintFee field.
Deploys BMMultipass, wires ERC20/whitelist/royalty addresses and pre-mints 250 team tokens.
Fallback payable receive function allowing ETH to be sent to the contract.
Builds the animated SVG and JSON metadata for a token and returns a base64 data URI.
ERC721A private _transfer that updates ownership/balance structs and timestamp of transfer.
ERC721A internal _mint that writes balance, ownership and timestamps and can invoke safe-mint receiver callbacks.
Private helper that calls IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on contract recipients and bubbles reverts via assembly.
Internal pure bit-packing helper combining eight trait fields into a single uint256.
Internal helper reading and decoding tokenIdToPackedData into a Data struct.
onlyOwner toggle controlling whether the whitelist check in claim can be skipped.
onlyOwner toggle enabling/disabling minting.
Mapping from token id to the compressed 256-bit trait/rarity payload.
Mapping tracking how many mints each whitelisted address has performed.
Public struct holding mintFee, maxSupply, OGPrivilege, mintingPermitted and bypassWhitelist flags.
Array of remaining supply per clearance level, decremented on each mint.
Array of cumulative trait totals used for rarity computation.
Owner-settable base URI used in image and metadata generation.
IERC20 handle for the Bytes token used as mint payment.
Whitelist contract handle used for merkle whitelist verification.
ERC721A counter of the next token id to be minted / total supply.
Whitelist contract array of accepted merkle roots.
msg.sender, used for mint accounting, ownership checks and trait entropy.
block.timestamp, used as pseudo-random entropy and as a stored transfer start time.
tx.origin, untrusted transaction origin (not used in the analysed logic but tracked as an attacker-controlled input).
External call BytesERC20.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount) pulling user tokens into the contract.
Low-level recipient.call{value: address(this).balance} in withdrawEth forwarding all ETH and all gas.
External call BytesERC20.transfer(_recipient, balance) in withdrawBytes.
External call to whiteListContract.isWhitelisted(msg.sender, position, proof) whose result gates minting.
Callback into arbitrary recipient contracts via IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received during safe mint/transfer.
Inline assembly blocks used in Base64, MerkleProof, Address and revert-bubbling helpers.
_BytesReceived parameter of claim: amount of Bytes offered for the mint.
_merkleProof calldata array used to validate whitelist membership.
_whitelist_position index used in the merkle leaf computation.
_quantity_to_mint parameter of _bulkClaim controlling the mint loop length.
_BytesReceived array parameter of _bulkClaim summed to determine the required Bytes.
_clearanceLevel parameter defining the assigned clearance level of the token.
_tokenId parameter identifying the token whose data is written.
_nonce parameter mixed into the pseudo-random trait selection hash.
Local accumulator summing the Bytes array and used as the transferFrom amount.
Local copy of available clearance level supplies mutated inside the mint loop.
Local variable holding the clearance level chosen for the current mint iteration.
Local keccak256-derived pseudo random value used to pick traits.
Local array of the six selected trait indices derived from pseudoRand.

edges.reason: msg.sender drives whitelist gating, mint counters and the minted-to address in claim.
msg.sender is used to check the Byte balance, pull tokens and receive the minted NFTs.
msg.sender is mixed into the pseudo-random hash used by _chooseTraitGivenArray.
msg.sender is used as entropy when computing trait selections.
block.timestamp is consumed as pseudo-random entropy, allowing miner/validator influence over trait selection.
block.timestamp is used to derive pseudo randomness for trait assignment.
block.timestamp is stored as the ownership startTimestamp on every transfer.
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender() before releasing all contract ETH.
onlyOwner gating of the ERC20 withdrawal relies on _msgSender().
claim requires the external whitelist check to pass unless bypassWhitelist is set.
claim builds a one-element array and delegates the mint work to _bulkClaim.
_bulkClaim performs the external transferFrom of Bytes before minting.
withdrawEth hands control and all gas to an arbitrary recipient address via call{value}, enabling reentrant behaviour.
The low-level value call to an attacker-controlled recipient can re-enter guarded or unguarded functions.
_bulkClaim calls _chooseTraitGivenArray each iteration to pick the clearance level.
_bulkClaim calls createDataGivenClearanceLevel for every token being minted.
_availClearanceLevels is initialized from the Byte amount and mutated each loop iteration.
_myClearanceLevel stores the chosen trait and is used to index supply arrays.
_requiredBytesTotal is computed from the Bytes array and drives the transferFrom amount.
_bulkClaim invokes _safeMint which reaches the ERC721 receiver callback path.
_mint calls _checkOnERC721Received during safe minting, transferring control to the recipient.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the external onERC721Received callback on untrusted recipient contracts.
initiate assigns a clearance level and calls createDataGivenClearanceLevel.
initiate requires the token's packed data to be zero and then it is populated.
createDataGivenClearanceLevel writes the packed trait data into tokenIdToPackedData.
pseudoRand is computed from keccak256 of timestamp, sender and tokenId and drives trait selection.
traitSelections holds the per-section trait indices written into the Data struct.
createDataGivenClearanceLevel packs the resulting Data fields through packData.
unpackData reads tokenIdToPackedData for the requested id.
tokenURI decodes the packed token data via unpackData.
tokenURI embeds the owner-controlled baseURI into the image and metadata output.
withdrawBytes transfers the contract's ERC20 balance to the recipient via an external call.
upgradeClearanceLevel rewrites tokenIdToPackedData with the new clearance level.
upgradeClearanceLevel repacks the modified Data struct through packData.
setMintFee writes a truncated uint208 value into contractSettings.mintFee.
setBypassWhitelist flips the bypassWhitelist flag inside contractSettings.
setMintingPermitted flips the mintingPermitted flag inside contractSettings.
currentIndex is included in the pseudo-random hash used for trait selection.
Available clearance level supply is passed into the trait chooser.
traitTotals are read to compute the rarity score of a token.
The BytesERC20 handle is the target of the transferFrom external call.
The whitelist contract handle is the target of the isWhitelisted external call.
The constructor pre-mints 250 tokens via _safeMint, exercising the receiver callback path.
tx.origin is an untrusted origin that could be abused by phishing-style authorisation flows around withdrawals.

normalization_plan.reason: _BytesReceived is the mint payment parameter consumed directly by claim before being forwarded to _bulkClaim.
_merkleProof exists only to satisfy the whitelist verification gate inside claim.
_whitelist_position is used solely in claim's whitelist check call.
_quantity_to_mint bounds the mint loop local to _bulkClaim.
The Bytes array parameter is summed and spent entirely inside _bulkClaim.
_clearanceLevel is a field of the generated Data written into tokenIdToPackedData.
_tokenId only identifies the storage slot written by createDataGivenClearanceLevel.
_nonce is mixed only into the randomness hash of _chooseTraitGivenArray.
_requiredBytesTotal is a loop accumulator used only for the transferFrom amount in _bulkClaim.
_availClearanceLevels is a temporary supply copy used only inside the _bulkClaim loop.
_myClearanceLevel is a per-iteration selection variable of _bulkClaim.
pseudoRand is the intermediate randomness value used solely inside createDataGivenClearanceLevel.
traitSelections is a temporary array holding the six trait picks before packing.
